svg.title: Minesweeper PSoC hardware schematic
svg.desc: System schematic showing PSoC Big Board connected to TFT display, joystick, buttons, and MP3 Voice Prompter
svg.text: Joystick connects to Port E header — no breadboard rows consumed.
MP3 module leads soldered, routed to Port D header pins in TopDesign.
All pin assignments made in PSoC Creator TopDesign — no physical rewiring of Port D/E.
